requirements.requirement: Do not persist to library before validation passes (staging state)
requirements.evidence: main.py fail-open default emits GLB regardless

requirements.requirement: Source priority: mfr land pattern > IPC-7351B > DFM > generic; record which

requirements.requirement: Stepped wizard with per-step previews

requirements.requirement: Capture manufacturer, MPN, description, category, datasheet URL/rev, distributor refs

requirements.requirement: Per-pin: number, name, electrical TYPE, FUNCTION, side, length/orientation, active-low, hidden

requirements.requirement: Mechanical fields WITH tolerances (min/nom/max): pitch, body LWH, lead, standoff, thermal, holes

requirements.requirement: Never invent a dimension — emit BLOCKED naming the missing dim
